The '''Battle of Haurgab''' was a battle that was fought on [[Haurgab]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The local [[Maujasi]] Clans rebelled against the local government and allied themselves with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], conducting several successful raids on [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] supply convoys. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] then sent in troops to stop them. During a particular raid, [[Omega Squad]] was able to kill the Maujasi leader, [[Jolluc]]. The battle continued to draw on for a month and more troops which included [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], were sent to the planet. The battle also served as a testing ground for the [[14th Infantry]], a newly-created batch of clones created in secret on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] recommended that the Republic abandon Haurgab, as the battle was pointless, believing the Maujasi would be just as much trouble for the Separatists and that no advantage would be lost if the planet joined the Separatists. As a result, the Republic eventually did withdraw its troops, ending the battle.
